package cardrpg

import (
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"math"
)

type Card struct {
	ID                         int64
	Template                   int
	Level, Stars, Shards, Gear int64
}

// DrawReceipt 是一次抽卡给调用方的结果：Key / Count / Cost / Balance / Misses 取自 gacha 的回执，Templates 是
// 道具换成的英雄模板。gacha 的回执固定成功结果，同一个 Key 在它的窗口内重放得到同一份（卡牌这边不再转换）。
type DrawReceipt struct {
	Key           string
	Count         int
	Templates     []int
	Cost, Balance int64
	Misses        int64
}
type Manage struct {
	Seq            uint64
	Kind           string
	CardID, Target int64
	Team           [3]int64
}
type Managed struct {
	Request    Manage
	ConfigHash string
}
type Admission struct {
	Seq        uint64
	RunID      int64
	Stage      int
	ConfigHash string
	Claimed    bool
}

// Profile 是卡牌自己的存档（PlayerDao.State，严格 JSON）。金币、钻石、尘、体力、抽卡保底与抽卡回执都在模块状态里
// （wallet / bag / stamina / gacha），这里只留模块没覆盖的：卡牌实例、编队、养成账本、开局账本、首通与战绩。
type Profile struct {
	Schema     int
	BattleKey  string // 服务器私有随机密钥（战斗随机流）；绝不进入客户端投影 / 日志。
	Cards      []Card
	Team       [3]int64
	Operations []Managed
	Runs       []Admission
	ActiveRun  int64
	Clears     [3]int
	Wins       int64
}

// Initial* 是新玩家的首次发放（event.EnterFirst 的监听在建档那笔事务里发）。
const (
	InitialGold int64 = 100
	InitialGems int64 = 100
	InitialDust int64 = 20
)

// NewBattleKey 用 crypto/rand 生成战斗随机流的私有密钥；只在服务端建档时调用。
func NewBattleKey() string {
	raw := make([]byte, 32)
	if _, err := rand.Read(raw); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(raw)
}

func NewProfile(key string) (Profile, error) {
	raw, err := hex.DecodeString(key)
	if err != nil || len(raw) != 32 {
		return Profile{}, ErrRule
	}
	p := Profile{Schema: 1, BattleKey: key, Team: [3]int64{1, 2, 3}}
	for i := range 3 {
		p.Cards = append(p.Cards, Card{ID: int64(i + 1), Template: i + 1, Level: 1, Stars: 1})
	}
	return p, nil
}
func (p Profile) Encode() string { return encode(p) }
func DecodeProfile(raw string) (Profile, error) {
	var p Profile
	if err := StrictJSON(raw, &p); err != nil {
		return p, err
	}
	key, err := hex.DecodeString(p.BattleKey)
	if err != nil || len(key) != 32 || p.Schema != 1 || len(p.Cards) < 3 || len(p.Cards) > 6 || len(p.Operations) > LedgerLimit || len(p.Runs) > LedgerLimit {
		return p, ErrRule
	}
	for i, c := range p.Cards {
		if c.ID != int64(c.Template) || c.Template < 1 || c.Template > 6 || c.Level < 1 || c.Level > 10 || c.Stars < 1 || c.Stars > 3 || c.Shards < 0 || c.Shards > 640 || c.Gear < 0 || c.Gear > 3 {
			return p, ErrRule
		}
		for j := 0; j < i; j++ {
			if p.Cards[j].ID == c.ID {
				return p, ErrRule
			}
		}
	}
	if !p.validTeam(p.Team) || p.Wins < 0 || p.Wins > ValueLimit {
		return p, ErrRule
	}
	validHash := func(value string) bool { raw, err := hex.DecodeString(value); return err == nil && len(raw) == 32 }
	for i, op := range p.Operations {
		if op.Request.Seq != uint64(i+1) || !validHash(op.ConfigHash) {
			return p, ErrRule
		}
	}
	active := 0
	for i, run := range p.Runs {
		if run.Seq != uint64(i+1) || run.RunID <= 0 || run.Stage < 1 || run.Stage > 3 || !validHash(run.ConfigHash) {
			return p, ErrRule
		}
		for j := 0; j < i; j++ {
			if p.Runs[j].RunID == run.RunID {
				return p, ErrRule
			}
		}
		if !run.Claimed {
			active++
			if run.RunID != p.ActiveRun {
				return p, ErrRule
			}
		}
	}
	if active > 1 || active == 0 && p.ActiveRun != 0 {
		return p, ErrRule
	}
	for _, stars := range p.Clears {
		if stars < 0 || stars > 3 {
			return p, ErrRule
		}
	}
	return p, nil
}
func (p *Profile) card(id int64) *Card {
	for i := range p.Cards {
		if p.Cards[i].ID == id {
			return &p.Cards[i]
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func (p Profile) validTeam(team [3]int64) bool {
	for i, id := range team {
		if p.card(id) == nil {
			return false
		}
		for j := 0; j < i; j++ {
			if team[j] == id {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

// HMAC 按领域、单调序号和槽位派生随机事实。测试密钥固定；正式服建档时用 crypto/rand 初始化私有密钥。
func (p Profile) random(domain string, seq uint64, slot int) uint64 {
	key, _ := hex.DecodeString(p.BattleKey)
	h := hmac.New(sha256.New, key)
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s:%d:%d", domain, seq, slot)
	return binary.BigEndian.Uint64(h.Sum(nil)[:8])
}
func (p Profile) BattleSeed(seq uint64) uint64 { return p.random("battle", seq, 0) | 1 }

// Collect 把 gacha 发进背包的一个英雄道具换成卡牌：没有这张卡就新建实例，已有就加一个碎片（重复卡转碎片，
// 另得 1 尘，由调用方经 bag 发）。返回模板号与是否重复。接收者是事务局部副本，调用方失败时整笔回滚。
func (p *Profile) Collect(itemID int64) (template int, duplicate bool, err error) {
	template, ok := HeroTemplate(itemID)
	if !ok {
		return 0, false, ErrRule
	}
	if owned := p.card(int64(template)); owned != nil {
		if owned.Shards >= 640 {
			return 0, false, ErrRule
		}
		owned.Shards++
		return template, true, nil
	}
	p.Cards = append(p.Cards, Card{ID: int64(template), Template: template, Level: 1, Stars: 1})
	return template, false, nil
}

// Effects 是一次养成操作要动的模块资产：Gold 是金币增减（wallet），Dust 是尘增减（bag），Energy 是要扣的体力
// （stamina）。Manage 只判卡牌自己的条件并改卡牌状态，资产够不够由 handler 调模块时判，不够整笔回滚。
type Effects struct {
	Gold, Dust, Energy int64
}

// Manage 共用永久顺序账本；旧序号只能重放相同业务内容（零效果），配置热更不重算已经成功的扣款。
func (p *Profile) Manage(c Manage, r Rules) (Effects, error) {
	if c.Seq == 0 {
		return Effects{}, ErrRule
	}
	if c.Seq <= uint64(len(p.Operations)) {
		if p.Operations[c.Seq-1].Request == c {
			return Effects{}, nil
		}
		return Effects{}, ErrRule
	}
	if c.Seq != uint64(len(p.Operations))+1 || len(p.Operations) >= LedgerLimit || r.Validate() != nil {
		return Effects{}, ErrRule
	}
	var e Effects
	switch c.Kind {
	case "team":
		if c.CardID != 0 || c.Target != 0 || !p.validTeam(c.Team) {
			return Effects{}, ErrRule
		}
		p.Team = c.Team
	case "level", "star", "gear":
		if c.Team != [3]int64{} {
			return Effects{}, ErrRule
		}
		card := p.card(c.CardID)
		if card == nil {
			return Effects{}, ErrRule
		}
		switch c.Kind {
		case "level":
			if c.Target != card.Level+1 || c.Target > 10 {
				return Effects{}, ErrRule
			}
			e = Effects{Gold: -5, Dust: -2}
			card.Level++
		case "star":
			if c.Target != card.Stars+1 || c.Target > 3 || card.Shards < 2 {
				return Effects{}, ErrRule
			}
			card.Shards -= 2
			e = Effects{Dust: -3}
			card.Stars++
		case "gear":
			if c.Target != card.Gear+1 || c.Target > 3 {
				return Effects{}, ErrRule
			}
			e = Effects{Gold: -3}
			card.Gear++
		}
	case "sweep":
		if c.CardID < 1 || c.CardID > 3 || c.Target < 1 || c.Target > 5 || c.Team != [3]int64{} || p.Clears[c.CardID-1] == 0 {
			return Effects{}, ErrRule
		}
		stage := r.Stages[c.CardID-1]
		e = Effects{Gold: stage.Gold * c.Target, Dust: c.Target, Energy: stage.Energy * c.Target}
	default:
		return Effects{}, ErrRule
	}
	p.Operations = append(p.Operations, Managed{Request: c, ConfigHash: r.Hash()})
	return e, nil
}

// View 明确裁剪私有密钥与内部重放账本；不要直接同步整个 DAO State 字符串。Gems / Gold / Dust / Energy 由 handler
// 从模块状态填（bag、wallet、stamina），卡牌存档里没有它们。
type ProfileView struct {
	Gems, Gold, Dust, Energy int64
	Cards                    []Card
	Team                     [3]int64
	ActiveRun                int64
	Clears                   [3]int
	Wins                     int64
}

func (p Profile) View() ProfileView {
	return ProfileView{Cards: append([]Card(nil), p.Cards...), Team: p.Team, ActiveRun: p.ActiveRun, Clears: p.Clears, Wins: p.Wins}
}
func ValidTime(now int64) bool { return now > 0 && now < math.MaxInt64-TurnMillis }
